owner_intro: The command that started Cleared printed a setup code. Type it here with the name and the password you will sign in with. The code works once, within 24 hours.
owner_code_hint: Eight letters and digits, as printed, for example ABCD-EFGH.
owner_name_hint: Letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores, up to 32.
owner_error_code_wrong: This is not the code Cleared printed. Check the output of the command that started it.
owner_error_code_expired: This code is more than 24 hours old. Restart Cleared to get a new one.
owner_error_name: A name is 1 to 32 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores, starting with a letter or a digit.
owner_error_service_account: This is the name of the machine account Cleared runs as. Pick another one.
owner_error_throttled: Too many tries. Wait {minutes} min, then try again.
owner_error_owner_exists: The owner's account already exists. Sign in instead.
owner_error_other: The account could not be created. Reload the page and try again.
owner_done_body: You are signed in as {name}. Cleared made its approval signature on this machine, where it stays.
owner_signing_title: So the release lock trusts your approvals
owner_signing_body: Add this line to the [tracker] section of your project's .cleared/agents.conf and commit it. It is public: it lets the lock check that an approval came from this app.
owner_signing_existed: A signature was already on this machine: this line is its public half.
owner_signing_missing: Cleared could not make its approval signature: the app's log says why. Run npm run setup in v2/ to make it.
